text:
maria: ok we need to finalize the hotpatch loader adapter interface before Monday. RFC flagged two compatibility issues w/ safetensors + chunked shards — want a quick alignment.
aj: can we keep manifest-less fallback for S3 shards? some customers only upload raw .safetensors pieces.
thomas: manifest-less is fine if the loader exposes per-shard basename + byte-range mapping. but we need a deterministic shard id -> placement map for hot-swap.
lia: streaming vs mmap differences matter: streaming path should avoid copy when possible. for mmap we can zero-copy map, for http streams we need a small staging buffer and async write.
maria: agreed. concern is commit semantics for swap: if we replace shard N while in-use, we must ensure in-flight KV-cache references don't see half-updated pointers.
aj: suggestion: make commit_swap() atomic and return a future/promise that resolves when old refs drained. API sketch below.
maria: ```
# minimal adapter interface
class HotPatchLoader:
    def open_shard(path) -> ShardHandle
    def read_tensor(handle, tensor_name, slice) -> bytes
    def prefetch(handle, keys) -> None
    def commit_swap(old_handle, new_handle) -> Future[bool]
```
lia: commit_swap future is good. also add a manifest_version header on handles so runtime can assert compatibility.
thomas: also need a fallback policy when commit_swap fails (partial write, corrupted safetensors). plan: immutable new file w/ checksum, verify before swap, else keep old and emit metric + alert.
maria: +1. what about shard indexing format? current safetensors index is fine but slow to parse for many small shards.
aj: propose an index cache: small binary index blob alongside shard (index.v1) that's memory-mapped. loader tries index.v1 -> if missing, synthesizes index from safetensors metadata and writes index.v1 atomically.
lia: that reduces startup warmup cost a lot. eviction: when memory pressure hits, we should evict LRU shard segments and keep index in memory.
thomas: one more: quantized weight variants. we should let handle carry a list of compatible variants (fp16, int8-q). commit_swap should allow variant promotion/demotion without changing tensor names.
maria: ops question: can infra handle rolling replacement across a pod group? infra-bot: deploy-bot says: "canary deploy for loader-adapter v1 scheduled for Thu 03:00UTC, will roll 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics stable." :thumbsup:
devex: please update the adapter example in docs and add the index.v1 contract + commit_swap behaviour, I'll add a short FAQ.
aj: plan: I'll prototype index cache + commit_swap future this week. rough timeline: prototype Thu, internal review Fri, canary next Thu.
maria: okay action items: aj implement prototype; lia add streaming/mmap test cases; thomas add checksum + rollback logic; devex draft docs. We'll reconvene Fri morning for a quick demo. :raised_hands:
